title: Authentication bypass in AuthMiddleware via unauthenticated test flag injection
summary: AuthMiddleware intercepts CLI commands to enforce RBAC identity resolution, but bypasses all authentication if any command-line argument has a '-test.' prefix or if ZQK_TEST_BYPASS_AUTH=1, immediately assigning full superuser privileges (ACC-TEST-HARNESS with read:*, write:*, delete:*, access:*). Any untrusted caller or subagent can append a dummy argument such as '-test.dummy' to bypass authentication entirely.
recommendation: Restrict test credential bypass strictly to compiled Go test binaries (such as checking flag.Lookup('test.v') or testing.Testing()) and eliminate naive os.Args string prefix inspections in production CLI binaries. Disallow unauthenticated environment variable overrides in production builds.
non_goals: Removing legitimate test harness execution in unit test suites
Refactoring the entirety of the RBAC context engine

evidence.detail: AuthMiddleware checks os.Args for '-test.' prefix and bypasses authentication
Invoking './bin/zqk system whoami -test.dummy' outputs Account ID: ACC-TEST-HARNESS with Roles: test and Permissions: read:*, write:*, delete:*, access:*

citations.point: Control 1.1: Architecture, Design and Threat Modeling - Security controls must fail closed and bypass mechanisms must not exist in production code.
Practice PW.1.2: Support secure coding practices to eliminate unauthenticated bypasses.

title: Processor defaults to full SystemSecurityContext when unbound by AuthMiddleware
summary: When cli.Processor initializes storage and RBAC contexts, if cmd.Context() does not carry an explicit SecurityContext, it defaults to NewSystemSecurityContext() (ACC-SYSTEM with admin role and read:*, write:*, delete:*). Any subcommand or internal subsystem creating a Processor outside AuthMiddleware runs with unrestricted system privileges.
recommendation: Enforce fail-closed security context initialization in cli.NewProcessor. Unbound contexts must default to an unauthenticated/guest context with zero permissions, requiring explicit elevated token acquisition for system tasks.
non_goals: Breaking developer workflows on standalone uninitialized repositories

evidence.detail: Processor falls back to NewSystemSecurityContext if no SecurityContext is found on context
draft_sweep_auth notes: 'Processor falls back to SystemSecurityContext when AuthMiddleware did not bind an ACC — that would make every unbound peer look elevated.'

citations.point: Control 4.1: Access Control Architecture - Verify that access control mechanisms default to denying access (fail-closed).
AC-3: Access Enforcement - Disallow access to unauthorized actors by default.

title: Quantum Sandbox allowlist permits compilers and utilities susceptible to arbitrary execution
summary: The MCP sandbox bash execution tool enforces an executable allowlist in checkSandboxAllowlist, but includes 'go', 'make', and 'find'. Invocations such as 'go run', 'go test -exec', 'make -f', or 'find -exec' permit arbitrary binary and code execution, effectively circumventing the sandbox restriction.
recommendation: Restrict 'go' invocations to specific safe subcommands (e.g. 'go vet', 'go test' with sanitized flags without -exec), disallow 'make' or require strict target validation, and strip '-exec'/'-ok' flags from 'find' universally across all paths.
non_goals: Disallowing legitimate test execution in automated agent workflows

evidence.detail: sandboxAllowedExecutableList includes 'go', 'make', 'find', and 'git'
handleAgentExecuteBashTool executes allowlisted commands via bash -c

citations.point: Control 12.1: Command Injection Prevention - Ensure execution environments strictly sanitize and constrain arguments to prevent command execution bypasses.
Protect the execution environment against hostile subversion and untrusted code execution.

title: CPCP boundary interceptor relies on naive tool name substrings and omits critical daemon directories
summary: The CPCP Boundary Contract interceptor (CPCP-MEMBRANE-001) inspects only tool names containing specific substring verbs ('write', 'create', 'edit', 'replace', 'delete', 'modify', 'patch') and argument keys containing 'path' or 'file'. It fails to intercept command execution tools (execute_bash), file copy/move operations, and omits protection for .zqk/run (privileged writer Unix socket) and .zqk/bin (stable binaries).
recommendation: Expand CPCPInterceptor to validate all tool invocations regardless of naming convention, intercept command execution tools, and protect the entirety of .zqk internal subdirectories (.zqk/run, .zqk/bin, .zqk/keystore) against unauthorized modification.
non_goals: Restricting normal read access to non-sensitive project files

evidence.detail: CPCPInterceptor checks only tool name substring matches and specific argument keys
checkProtectedPath only checks .zqk/process, .zqk/streams, .zqk/cas, .zqk/wal; omitting .zqk/run and .zqk/bin

title: Tray entry signature verification requires private key and omits appended arguments
summary: Verification of restricted tray commands loads the private key (.zqk/keystore/auditor.priv) rather than a trusted public key, generating a new private key on disk if absent. Furthermore, verification only checks e.Argv from the manifest, ignoring appended user/agent arguments and default tray entries, permitting execution of unverified privileged flags.
recommendation: Decouple signature verification from private key storage by verifying signatures exclusively against an explicit public key or certificate. Include runtime appended arguments in the cryptographic digest verification, and enforce verification on default entries when privileged flags are supplied.
non_goals: Disallowing convenient local shortcuts for standard developer workflows

evidence.detail: runRun loads private key via NewAuditorSigner and verifies only e.Argv instead of fullArgv; default entries bypass verification
NewAuditorSigner generates a new private key and writes it to keyPath if missing
VerifyEntry verifies only e.Name and e.Argv

citations.point: Recommendation for Key Management - Part 1: Clear separation of private signing keys and public verification keys.
Control 10.3: Deployed Cryptography - Verify that cryptographic operations ensure integrity of all executable parameters without relying on private key exposure.

verification_proof: Remediated in codebase and verified under unit/race tests

title: Unauthenticated HTTP endpoints with unbounded request bodies and missing Origin validation
summary: Multiple HTTP listeners exhibit security weaknesses: CallbackListenerHandler leaves authenticateRequest unused as dead code, exposing /callbacks/trigger unauthenticated; ambient /ingest reads request bodies using io.ReadAll without MaxBytesReader; telemetry WebSocket hijacks connections without Origin validation (CSWSH); and agentfeed httpapi token checks use non-constant-time comparisons.
recommendation: Activate and enforce authentication in CallbackListenerHandler, apply http.MaxBytesReader to ambient /ingest endpoints, validate the Origin header on WebSocket upgrade handshakes, and utilize subtle.ConstantTimeCompare for API tokens.
non_goals: Mandating mTLS for local development testing loops

evidence.detail: authenticateRequest is unused in production; handleCallback processes /trigger and /job/* without authentication
ambient ingest reads request body into memory without limit using io.ReadAll
WebSocket upgrade does not check Origin header before hijacking connection
withAuth uses non-constant-time string equality check got != tok

citations.point: Control 5.1: Input Validation - Ensure that large payloads are bounded to prevent memory exhaustion (DoS).
The WebSocket Protocol - Section 10.2: Origin header must be validated to prevent Cross-Origin WebSocket Hijacking.

verification_proof: Remediated in codebase and verified under unit/race tests

title: Scheduler run wrapper interpolates direct executable commands through /bin/sh
summary: The scheduler command runner forces direct, non-shell executable commands through /bin/sh -c with string interpolation of jobTag and command path in order to attach the ZQK_JOB_ID environment tag to process listings. This needlessly expands the command execution surface and risks parameter expansion anomalies.
recommendation: Execute non-shell commands directly via exec.Command without wrapping in /bin/sh -c. Rely on cmd.Env to pass ZQK_JOB_ID, or use platform-specific process title APIs where supported.
non_goals: Preventing intentional shell script execution where shell scripts are explicitly configured

evidence.detail: Direct commands are wrapped inside /bin/sh -c with unquoted jobTag and escapedCmd interpolation

Execute binaries directly with discrete argument slices rather than delegating to /bin/sh -c.

title: Privileged writer IPC server checkAffinity bypasses validation on empty project root
summary: The PrivilegedWriterDaemon checkAffinity method skips project root affinity validation if args.ProjectRoot is empty, allowing un-scoped clients to execute mutations against whatever workspace root the daemon process serves. Additionally, the daemon initialization conditionally inherits an ambient user API key instead of enforcing the system service account.
recommendation: Enforce that args.ProjectRoot is non-empty and matches the daemon projectRoot strictly in checkAffinity. In daemon.go, unconditionally overwrite ZQK_API_KEY with SystemAccountID upon daemon start.
non_goals: Changing the underlying net/rpc transport protocol

evidence.detail: checkAffinity returns nil if d.projectRoot == '' or args.ProjectRoot == ''
Daemon only sets SystemAccountID if ZQK_API_KEY is not already set in environment

title: Zero detected secrets, credentials, or prohibited paths committed across candidate tree
summary: Repository-wide scans utilizing ./scripts/scan-secrets.sh, ./bin/zqk system export-gate, and police scripts confirmed zero committed private keys, API secrets, passwords, or prohibited proprietary assets across 8,452 tracked repository files.
recommendation: Maintain automated CI enforcement of scan-secrets.sh and export-gate on all PR submissions to ensure zero credential or sensitive asset ingress.
non_goals: Modifying the active scanning rules or secret detection entropy thresholds

evidence.detail: ./scripts/scan-secrets.sh . scans all files and returns exit 0 with 'Zero secrets detected.'
./bin/zqk system export-gate checks 8,381 files and returns exit 0 with 'PASS: clean'
